recipes.name: onboard-employee
recipes.goal: Onboard a brand-new employee end to end: create the person (with their start date and optional contact details), assign their employment contract, and add them to a group — all in one guided flow.

goalTranslations.de: Einen neuen Mitarbeiter komplett erfassen: Person anlegen, Arbeitsvertrag zuweisen und einer Gruppe hinzufügen — alles in einem geführten Ablauf.
goalTranslations.en: Onboard a new employee end to end: create the person, assign the employment contract and add them to a group — all in one guided flow.
goalTranslations.fr: Intégrer un nouvel employé de bout en bout : créer la personne, attribuer le contrat de travail et l'ajouter à un groupe — le tout dans un flux guidé.
goalTranslations.it: Inserire un nuovo dipendente dall'inizio alla fine: creare la persona, assegnare il contratto di lavoro e aggiungerla a un gruppo — tutto in un flusso guidato.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the full name (first and last name) of the new employee to onboard.

promptTranslations.de: Wie lautet der vollständige Name (Vor- und Nachname) des neuen Mitarbeiters?
promptTranslations.en: What is the full name (first and last name) of the new employee?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom complet (prénom et nom) du nouvel employé ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome completo (nome e cognome) del nuovo dipendente?

steps.description: the full name (first and last name) of the new employee

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the employee's gender (male / female / other).

promptTranslations.de: Welches Geschlecht hat der neue Mitarbeiter (männlich / weiblich / divers)?
promptTranslations.en: What is the employee's gender (male / female / other)?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le genre de l'employé (homme / femme / autre) ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il genere del dipendente (maschile / femminile / altro)?

steps.description: the gender of the employee

steps.prompt: Ask the user from which date the employee starts working (Eintrittsdatum / start date). This drives the membership start and therefore the schedule's plannability boundary. Offer a date picker by appending [REPLIES:date "Ab wann?"].

promptTranslations.de: Ab welchem Datum beginnt der neue Mitarbeiter zu arbeiten (Eintrittsdatum)? [REPLIES:date "Ab wann?"]
promptTranslations.en: From which date does the new employee start working? [REPLIES:date "From when?"]
promptTranslations.fr: À partir de quelle date le nouvel employé commence-t-il à travailler ? [REPLIES:date "À partir de quand ?"]
promptTranslations.it: Da quale data inizia a lavorare il nuovo dipendente? [REPLIES:date "Da quando?"]

steps.description: the employee's start date (Eintrittsdatum), as a calendar date yyyy-MM-dd

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the employee's contact details — postal address (street, ZIP, city), email and phone. These are strongly recommended; if the user explicitly does not want to provide any, they may say so.

promptTranslations.de: Wie lauten die Kontaktdaten des Mitarbeiters — Adresse (Strasse, PLZ, Ort), E-Mail und Telefon?
promptTranslations.en: What are the employee's contact details — postal address (street, ZIP, city), email and phone?
promptTranslations.fr: Quelles sont les coordonnées de l'employé — adresse postale (rue, NPA, ville), e-mail et téléphone ?
promptTranslations.it: Quali sono i dati di contatto del dipendente — indirizzo postale (via, CAP, città), e-mail e telefono?

steps.description: the employee's address, email and phone (optional but strongly recommended)

steps.note: Create the new employee now. Split the full name (known value employeeName) into firstName and lastName. Map the gender (known value) to the enum value Male/Female/Intersexuality/LegalEntity (e.g. 'weiblich'/'Frau'/'female' -> Female, 'männlich'/'Mann'/'male' -> Male). Use the start date the user gave (known value startDate) as memberSince, formatted yyyy-MM-dd — resolve 'heute'/'today' to today's date and 'morgen' to tomorrow; never invent a date. entityType defaults to Employee. From the contact details (known value contactDetails) fill street, zip, city, email and phone when given; if the user explicitly declined to provide any contact data, set proceedWithoutContact=true. Relay the created employee back to the user.

steps.prompt: Ask the user which employment contract the new employee should get (the contract name).

promptTranslations.de: Welchen Arbeitsvertrag soll der neue Mitarbeiter erhalten (Vertragsname)?
promptTranslations.en: Which employment contract should the new employee get (the contract name)?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel contrat de travail le nouvel employé doit-il recevoir (nom du contrat) ?
promptTranslations.it: Quale contratto di lavoro deve ricevere il nuovo dipendente (nome del contratto)?

steps.description: the name of the employment contract to assign to the new employee

steps.note: Assign the employment contract to the employee just created. contractName is supplied. Resolve the employee by name: split the full name (known value employeeName) into firstName and lastName. Use the employee's start date (known value startDate) as fromDate, formatted yyyy-MM-dd; leave untilDate empty for an indefinite contract. If the contract name is ambiguous, the skill lists the available contracts — relay those and ask the user to pick, never invent one.

steps.prompt: Ask the user which group the new employee should be added to (the group name).

promptTranslations.de: Zu welcher Gruppe soll der neue Mitarbeiter hinzugefügt werden (Gruppenname)?
promptTranslations.en: Which group should the new employee be added to (the group name)?
promptTranslations.fr: À quel groupe le nouvel employé doit-il être ajouté (nom du groupe) ?
promptTranslations.it: A quale gruppo deve essere aggiunto il nuovo dipendente (nome del gruppo)?

steps.description: the name of the group the new employee should be added to

steps.note: Add the new employee to the group. groupName is supplied. Resolve the employee by name: split the full name (known value employeeName) into firstName and lastName. Use the employee's start date (known value startDate) as validFrom, formatted yyyy-MM-dd. This skill rejects duplicates, so it safely refuses if the employee is already in the group. Relay the result, then summarise the whole onboarding (employee created, contract assigned, group added) to the user.

recipes.name: user-onboarding
recipes.goal: Create a new system login account (AppUser) for the user administration and assign it a permission role — a guided flow for system accounts, not HR employees/clients.

goalTranslations.de: Ein neues Login-Konto (Systembenutzer) anlegen und ihm eine Berechtigungsrolle zuweisen.
goalTranslations.en: Create a new system login account and assign it a permission role.
goalTranslations.fr: Créer un nouveau compte de connexion (utilisateur système) et lui attribuer un rôle d'autorisation.
goalTranslations.it: Creare un nuovo account di accesso (utente di sistema) e assegnargli un ruolo di autorizzazione.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the full name (first and last name) of the person who should get the new login account.

promptTranslations.de: Wie lautet der vollständige Name (Vor- und Nachname) der Person, die das neue Login-Konto erhalten soll?
promptTranslations.en: What is the full name (first and last name) of the person who should get the new login account?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom complet (prénom et nom) de la personne qui doit recevoir le nouveau compte de connexion ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome completo (nome e cognome) della persona che deve ricevere il nuovo account di accesso?

steps.description: the full name (first and last name) of the person who should get the new login account

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the email address of the new login account.

promptTranslations.de: Wie lautet die E-Mail-Adresse für das neue Login-Konto?
promptTranslations.en: What is the email address for the new login account?
promptTranslations.fr: Quelle est l'adresse e-mail du nouveau compte de connexion ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è l'indirizzo e-mail del nuovo account di accesso?

steps.description: the email address of the new login account

steps.note: Create the new login account now. email is supplied — do not ask for it again. Split the full name (known value fullName) into firstName and lastName. Relay the created username back to the user; a password is generated automatically and is intentionally not shown.

steps.prompt: Ask the user which permission level the new account should get: Admin (full access), Supervisor (create/edit access without settings) or User (view-only).

promptTranslations.de: Welche Berechtigungsstufe soll das neue Konto erhalten: Admin (Vollzugriff), Supervisor (Erstellen/Bearbeiten ohne Einstellungen) oder User (nur Lesen)?
promptTranslations.en: Which permission level should the new account get: Admin (full access), Supervisor (create/edit without settings) or User (view-only)?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel niveau d'autorisation le nouveau compte doit-il recevoir : Admin (accès complet), Supervisor (création/édition sans paramètres) ou User (lecture seule) ?
promptTranslations.it: Quale livello di autorizzazione deve ricevere il nuovo account: Admin (accesso completo), Supervisor (creazione/modifica senza impostazioni) o User (sola lettura)?

steps.description: the permission level for the new account: Admin, Supervisor or User

steps.note: Assign the permission level now. Resolve the target user via userName using the full name (known value fullName) just created — do not pass userId, it was never captured. Map the role the user chose (known value roleChoice) to the exact allowed values: 'Admin' -> Admin; 'Supervisor'/'Authorised'/'Sachbearbeiter' -> Authorised; 'User'/'Benutzer'/'Standard' -> User. Relay the confirmed role and permission set, then summarise the whole flow (login account created, role assigned) to the user.

recipes.name: record-employee-address-change
recipes.goal: Record an address change (relocation) for an employee: capture the new postal address with its valid-from date as a new address entry, keeping the old address as history.

goalTranslations.de: Einen Umzug eines Mitarbeiters erfassen: die neue Postadresse mit Gültig-ab-Datum als neuen Adresseintrag anlegen — die alte Adresse bleibt als Historie erhalten.

goalTranslations.it: Registrare un trasloco di un dipendente: creare il nuovo indirizzo postale con la data di validità come nuova voce — il vecchio indirizzo rimane come cronologia.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the full name (first and last name) of the employee whose address changes.

promptTranslations.de: Wie heisst der Mitarbeiter, dessen Adresse sich ändert (Vor- und Nachname)?
promptTranslations.en: What is the full name (first and last name) of the employee whose address changes?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom complet (prénom et nom) de l'employé dont l'adresse change ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome completo (nome e cognome) del dipendente il cui indirizzo cambia?

steps.description: the full name (first and last name) of the employee whose address changes

steps.note: Find the employee. The search term and entityType='Employee' are supplied — customers are excluded. The recipe captures the matching employee automatically when exactly one matches.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the new postal address: street and house number, postal code, city, and country if it is not Switzerland.

promptTranslations.de: Wie lautet die neue Adresse (Strasse und Hausnummer, PLZ, Ort — und Land, falls nicht Schweiz)?
promptTranslations.en: What is the new address (street and house number, postal code, city — and country if not Switzerland)?
promptTranslations.fr: Quelle est la nouvelle adresse (rue et numéro, code postal, localité — et pays si hors Suisse) ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nuovo indirizzo (via e numero civico, CAP, località — e paese se non in Svizzera)?

steps.description: the new postal address as street, postal code, city and optional country

steps.prompt: Ask the user from which date the new address is valid. Offer a date picker by appending [REPLIES:date "Ab wann?"].

promptTranslations.de: Ab welchem Datum gilt die neue Adresse? [REPLIES:date "Ab wann?"]
promptTranslations.en: From which date is the new address valid? [REPLIES:date "From when?"]
promptTranslations.fr: À partir de quelle date la nouvelle adresse est-elle valable ? [REPLIES:date "À partir de quand ?"]
promptTranslations.it: Da quale data è valido il nuovo indirizzo? [REPLIES:date "Da quando?"]

steps.description: the date from which the new address is valid (yyyy-MM-dd)

steps.note: Create the new address now. clientId and validFrom are supplied — do not ask for them; format validFrom as yyyy-MM-dd. Parse the address the user gave (slot newAddress in the known values) into street, zip, city and, when mentioned, country and state. Keep type at its default 0 (home address) unless the user explicitly asked for a workplace (1) or invoicing (2) address. Do NOT delete or modify the old address — it remains as history and the UI switches automatically on the valid-from date. Relay the verified confirmation from the skill result including the valid-from date.

recipes.name: offboard-employee
recipes.goal: Record an employee's exit: set the end date of their active membership so the schedule stops planning them after the last working day.

goalTranslations.de: Den Austritt eines Mitarbeiters erfassen: das Austrittsdatum der aktiven Mitgliedschaft setzen — ab dem Folgetag ist die Person nicht mehr einplanbar.
goalTranslations.en: Record an employee's exit: set the end date of the active membership — from the following day the person can no longer be planned.
goalTranslations.fr: Enregistrer le départ d'un employé : fixer la date de fin de l'affiliation active — dès le lendemain, la personne n'est plus planifiable.
goalTranslations.it: Registrare l'uscita di un dipendente: impostare la data di fine dell'appartenenza attiva — dal giorno successivo la persona non è più pianificabile.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the full name (first and last name) of the employee who is leaving.

promptTranslations.de: Wie heisst der Mitarbeiter, der austritt (Vor- und Nachname)?
promptTranslations.en: What is the full name (first and last name) of the employee who is leaving?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom complet (prénom et nom) de l'employé qui part ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome completo (nome e cognome) del dipendente che esce?

steps.description: the full name (first and last name) of the employee who is leaving

steps.note: Find the employee. The search term and entityType='Employee' are supplied — customers are excluded. The recipe captures the matching employee automatically when exactly one matches.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the employee's last working day (the membership ends on this date). Offer a date picker by appending [REPLIES:date "Letzter Arbeitstag?"].

promptTranslations.de: Was ist der letzte Arbeitstag des Mitarbeiters? [REPLIES:date "Letzter Arbeitstag?"]
promptTranslations.en: What is the employee's last working day? [REPLIES:date "Last working day?"]
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le dernier jour de travail de l'employé ? [REPLIES:date "Dernier jour ?"]
promptTranslations.it: Qual è l'ultimo giorno di lavoro del dipendente? [REPLIES:date "Ultimo giorno?"]

steps.description: the last working day of the employee (yyyy-MM-dd)

steps.note: End the active membership now. clientId and exitDate are supplied — do not ask for them; format exitDate as yyyy-MM-dd. If the skill reports several active memberships, relay the real options (ids and periods) and call the skill again with the membershipId the user picks — do not guess. Relay the verified confirmation and remind the user that the person can no longer be planned in the schedule after the exit date; booked shifts after that date are not removed automatically.

recipes.name: close-payroll-period
recipes.goal: Guided payroll period closing: run a pre-flight issue check for the period, present the findings to the user, and seal the period only after their explicit confirmation.

goalTranslations.en: Guided payroll period closing: pre-flight issue check for the period, present the findings, then seal the period only after explicit confirmation.
goalTranslations.fr: Clôture guidée de la période de paie : vérification préalable des problèmes, présentation des résultats, puis scellement de la période uniquement après confirmation explicite.
goalTranslations.it: Chiusura guidata del periodo di paga: verifica preliminare dei problemi, presentazione dei risultati, poi sigillatura del periodo solo dopo conferma esplicita.

steps.prompt: Ask the user which period should be closed — a start and end date (e.g. 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30) or a month like 'June 2026', optionally restricted to one group.

promptTranslations.de: Welche Periode soll abgeschlossen werden — Start- und Enddatum (z. B. 2026-06-01 bis 2026-06-30) oder ein Monat wie 'Juni 2026', optional beschränkt auf eine Gruppe?
promptTranslations.en: Which period should be closed — a start and end date (e.g. 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30) or a month like 'June 2026', optionally restricted to one group?
promptTranslations.fr: Quelle période doit être clôturée — une date de début et de fin (p. ex. 2026-06-01 au 2026-06-30) ou un mois comme « juin 2026 », éventuellement limitée à un groupe ?
promptTranslations.it: Quale periodo deve essere chiuso — una data di inizio e di fine (per es. 2026-06-01 al 2026-06-30) o un mese come 'giugno 2026', eventualmente limitato a un gruppo?

steps.description: the period to close (start/end date or a month, optionally a group)

steps.note: Pre-flight check before sealing. Map the user's period (slot period in the known values) to startDate and endDate as yyyy-MM-dd — a named month means its first and last day. If the user named a group, pass groupName. Present the errors, warnings and notes to the user (list the concrete findings if there are few); never skip or summarise away errors.

steps.prompt: Present the pre-flight findings, then ask whether the period should be sealed now. If there are errors, recommend fixing them first and ask explicitly whether to seal anyway.

promptTranslations.de: Soll die Periode jetzt versiegelt werden? Falls es Fehler gibt: zuerst beheben oder trotzdem versiegeln?
promptTranslations.en: Should the period be sealed now? If there are errors: fix them first or seal anyway?
promptTranslations.fr: La période doit-elle être scellée maintenant ? S'il y a des erreurs : les corriger d'abord ou sceller quand même ?
promptTranslations.it: Il periodo deve essere sigillato adesso? Se ci sono errori: correggerli prima o sigillare comunque?

steps.description: whether the user wants to seal now despite the findings

steps.note: Seal the period ONLY if the user explicitly agreed in the goAhead answer (see the known values); if they declined or want to fix issues first, do NOT call this skill — help with the issues instead. Use the same startDate/endDate (and optional groupName) as in the pre-flight check, and pass the user's stated reason if any. Relay the skill's sealed/verified result to the user.

steps.prompt: Ask which of the shipped industries the business is most comparable to — homecare, healthcare, security, facility or logistics — or 'scratch' to start from a blank rule. Explain the consequence: picking an industry copies all of its scheduling-rule templates into the company's own editable rules, while starting blank creates a single empty rule filled entirely from the answers that follow. Offer the six choices as single-select replies and pass the chosen slug on.

promptTranslations.en: Which of the shipped industries is your business most comparable to — homecare, healthcare, security, facility services or logistics? That industry's templates are copied as your own editable rules. Alternatively we start blank, which creates a single empty rule filled entirely from your answers.
promptTranslations.fr: À quel secteur votre entreprise ressemble-t-elle le plus — soins à domicile, santé, sécurité, services immobiliers ou logistique ? Les modèles de ce secteur sont copiés comme vos propres règles modifiables. Sinon nous partons de zéro, ce qui crée une seule règle vide remplie entièrement par vos réponses.
promptTranslations.it: A quale settore assomiglia di più la vostra azienda — assistenza domiciliare, sanità, sicurezza, servizi immobiliari o logistica? I modelli di quel settore vengono copiati come regole proprie e modificabili. In alternativa partiamo da zero, creando una sola regola vuota riempita interamente dalle vostre risposte.

steps.description: the industry the business is most comparable to, or scratch for a blank start

steps.note: Open the planning-profile draft with the base the user just chose. Map their answer to one of the slugs homecare, healthcare, security, facility, logistics or scratch before passing it. The skill returns the checklist of the remaining parameters with each one's meaning, planning impact, type and valid range: continue the dialogue from there, ask for exactly one value at a time with set_planning_profile_parameters, and use the number-field reply format with the checklist's min and max whenever you ask for a number. Finish with preview_planning_profile and, after the user confirms, apply_planning_profile.
